arguments.question: For ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA over 21/63 sessions, use seeded daily prices and fixed SPY plus XLK/XLC benchmarks to describe dated trend, relative-performance and volatility/drawdown evidence. Identify common versus issuer-specific technical risk and transparent review levels only if supported by observed bars; do not make a directional forecast. Stop after the seeded series.
arguments.decision_impact: Tests whether price trend/relative behavior corroborates or challenges fundamental theses and supplies objective review conditions across the watchlist.
